curve.modNote: In-between percents are the median moving average of players running the mod whose mark sat within ±{band} points of that percent over the last {days} days. Missing percents are never filled in.
curve.onlyThresholds: Only the 65, 85, 95 and 100% thresholds are backed by data. In-between steps appear once at least {minPlayers} players running the mod reach each percent on this tank within {days} days.
curve.emptyDescription: This tank has neither mark thresholds nor data from players running the mod yet.
